senses.gloss: (denom. of צִיּוּן) to put up a pile, to mark.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 1:1">Shek. I, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">M. Kat. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 2a">2ᵃ</cite>) <he>מְצַיְּינִין על הקברות</he> Y. ed. (Bab. ed. a. Mish. <cite ref="G00078"><he>את</he></cite>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) graves are marked (with lime). Ib. 5ᵇ <he>שדה … קבר וצִיְּינוּהָ</he> (not <he>דצ׳</he>) a field in which a grave was lost, and which they marked.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 5:1">Maas. Sh. V, 1</cite> <he>כרם רבעי מציינין וכ׳</he> a vineyard in the fourth year is marked with clods of earth, … and graves with lime &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:14">Y. Shek. I, 46ᵃ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">M. Kat. I, 2</cite>) <he>לא כבר צִיְּינוּ מאדר</he> had they not marked them in Adar? <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:2">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <he>ובנה</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 39:15">Ez. XXXIX, 15</cite>) <he>מיכן שמציינין ע״ג אבן קבועה</he> from this we learn that the mark is put on a fixed stone; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02287"><he>מְצוּיָּין</he></cite>, <he>מְצוּיָּן</he>; f. <he>מְצוּיֶּינֶת</he>, <he>מְצוּיֶּנ׳</he>; Pl. <he>מְצוּיָּינִים</he>, <he>מְצוּיָּינִין</he>; <he>מְצוּיָּינוֹת</he>, <he>מְצוּיָּנ׳</he>.

<cite ref="Ezekiel 39:15">Ib.</cite>; Tosef. ib. I, 5 <he>מצא אבן אחת מצ׳ וכ׳</he> if one found a single stone marked, although this ought not to be done (several stones surrounding the marked spot being required by law) &c.; <cite ref="Moed Katan 6a:7">M. Kat. 6ᵃ</cite>.
Ib. 5ᵇ מצא שדה אחת מצ׳ וכ׳ if one found a field marked, and knows not for what purpose; a. fr.—[Lev. R. s. 6 מציינין, v. צָוַץ.]—Trnsf. to distinguish, make prominent, adorn.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q02165"><he>פָּתִיל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 145b:10-13">Sabb. 145ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מה … מצ׳</he> why are the scholars in Babylonia distinguished (in their dress)? <cite ref="Berakhot 8a:17">Ber. 8ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>שערי ציון</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 87:2">Ps. LXXXVII, 2</cite>) <he>שערים המצ׳ בהלכה</he> gates prominent for learned decisions.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 43:8">Sifré Deut. 43</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 31:20">Jer. XXXI, 20</cite>) <he>היו מצ׳ במצות וכ׳</he> distinguish yourselves by observing (in exile) religious laws (meant for Palestine), so that they be not new to you, when you return; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:4">Cant. R. to VI, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 713">Yalk. Num. 713</cite>, read: <he>מְצוּיָּירוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="R00241"><he>צוּר</he> II</cite>.]

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 19</cite> (ref. to Jer. l. c.) <he>הִצַּיְּינִי במצות וכ׳</he> adorn thyself with the religious observances by which Israel was distinguished (in Palestine), v. supra.
